_doc: Wasabi (S3-compatible) cloud storage taxonomy + auto-sort rules + lifecycle. Secrets live in .env.secrets (WASABI_KEY/WASABI_SECRET), NEVER here. The migration + runtime access layer (server/services/cloud_storage.py) reads this to decide WHERE every file goes and records WHERE it moved in the manifest (server/data/cloud_manifest.db).
_endpoint_note: ap-southeast-2 (Sydney) is the closest Wasabi region to the AU owner; override via WASABI_REGION/WASABI_ENDPOINT env. Other regions: us-east-1/us-east-2/us-west-1/eu-central-1/ap-northeast-1.
_bucket_note: Two buckets only (Wasabi allows 1000 but prefixes scale better). 'primary' = normal hot/cold data via prefixes. 'immutable' = Object-Lock-enabled bucket for backups that must never be altered (MUST be created with Object Lock ON — cannot be added later).

integrity._checksum_note: Force MD5 — AWS SDK/CLI v2 default CRC64NVME ERRORS against Wasabi. rclone uses MD5 natively.

sorting_rules._doc: Evaluated top-to-bottom; first match wins. 'when' matches by ext (lowercased) and/or path substring (case-insensitive). 'to' = bucket:prefix. {cat} is filled from the path for UnderworldAssets categories; {yyyy}/{mm} from the file mtime.

lifecycle._doc: Prefix lifecycle rules. Mind Wasabi's 90-day minimum storage charge — do NOT expire sooner than 90d. Versions kept for safety; old noncurrent versions expired after retention.

migration._doc: What the migration scans. include = dirs eligible to move to cloud (cold/archival). exclude = NEVER move (live, active, code, engine). dry_run_default true so nothing moves without explicit --apply.
migration.exclude_note: Live UE5 PROJECT files (Content the editor reads), live DBs, code, secrets and the engine are NEVER migrated — only confirmed cold/archival output. Add dirs to 'include' deliberately.
migration.after_verify_note: Default keep_local (safest): upload + verify, leave originals untouched. Switch to replace_with_pointer (leaves a .cloudref json) or delete_local ONLY after you trust the migration and have verified checksums.
